meta.description: Privacy policy for HeatEx Direct, explaining how we handle quote request data, email verification, contact messages, manufacturer profile updates, content inquiries, and site usage information.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: This policy explains what information HeatEx Direct collects, why we collect it, and how it is used when you browse the website, submit RFQ information, contact us, or update a manufacturer profile.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: HeatEx Direct is an independent sourcing information platform for Chinese industrial heat exchanger manufacturers. We process information to operate the website, organize manufacturer and product content, respond to buyer and supplier inquiries, and support structured quote request follow-up.

informationWeCollect.title: 2. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We may collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, company name, role, country or region, message content, manufacturer profile update details, website links, uploaded or shared files, article or news submissions, and any information you include when contacting us.

quoteRequests.title: 3. Quote Request and Technical Data
quoteRequests.content: When you submit an RFQ or sourcing request, we may collect project context and technical parameters such as equipment type, application industry, media, phase, flow rate, temperatures, pressure, materials, standards, quantity, target market, project notes, and your verifiable email address. This information helps us understand whether the request is clear enough for follow-up.

emailVerification.title: 4. Email Verification
emailVerification.content: Some workflows may use email verification to confirm that a request or contact email is real. We process the submitted email address and verification token only for verification, fraud reduction, request review, and follow-up related to the website workflow.

manufacturerData.title: 5. Manufacturer Profile and Supplier Information
manufacturerData.content: If a manufacturer or authorized representative asks us to correct, complete, or update a profile, we may collect company descriptions, product information, contact details, media files, certificates, brochures, websites, public-source references, and other materials needed to review or update the page.

automaticData.title: 6. Site Usage, Cookies, and Language Preferences
automaticData.content: We may collect basic technical data such as IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, referral source, approximate location, and interaction data through hosting logs, analytics, cookies, or similar technologies. We may also store language preferences so the site can show the correct language version.

howWeUse.title: 7. How We Use Information
howWeUse.content: We use information to operate the website, respond to messages, review RFQ submissions, clarify missing project details, update manufacturer profiles, manage content and partnership discussions, improve page quality, protect the platform from misuse, analyze site performance, and comply with legal obligations.

sharing.title: 8. When Information May Be Shared
sharing.content: We do not sell your contact information to marketing brokers. We may share relevant request details with team members, service providers that help us operate the site, and, when appropriate for sourcing follow-up, potential suppliers or partners. We share only what is reasonably needed for the relevant workflow.

publicContent.title: 9. Public Manufacturer and Product Content
publicContent.content: Manufacturer profiles, product pages, industry articles, media, files, and public-source information may be published on the website. If you provide supplier materials for publication, you confirm that you have the right to share them and understand that approved content may become publicly accessible.

retentionSecurity.title: 10. Retention and Security
retentionSecurity.content: We keep information for as long as reasonably needed to operate the platform, respond to inquiries, maintain records, improve content quality, or meet legal and business requirements. We use reasonable safeguards, but no online transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be fully secure.

rights.title: 11. Your Choices and Requests
rights.content: You may contact us to request correction, update, or deletion of information you submitted, subject to reasonable verification, legal requirements, and operational needs. Manufacturers may also request profile corrections or ask us to review outdated materials.

contact.title: 12. Contact and Policy Updates
contact.content: If you have questions about this policy or how your information is handled, please use the email address listed on the Contact page. We may update this Privacy Policy as the website, RFQ workflow, content services, or legal requirements change.
